gloss: imperial throne; the position of emperor

definitions.gloss: imperial throne; the position of emperor
definitions.explanation: The status or position of the emperor. Used in discussions of succession, abdication, and the institution of the Japanese monarchy.

examples.japanese: {皇位|こうい}を{継承|けいしょう}する。
2019{年|ねん}に{皇位|こうい}{継承|けいしょう}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The imperial succession took place in 2019.

examples.japanese: {上皇|じょうこう}は{皇位|こうい}を{退|しりぞ}かれ、{新|あたら}しい{天皇|てんのう}が{即位|そくい}された。
examples.english: The Emperor Emeritus abdicated, and the new Emperor ascended the throne.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{皇位|こうい} is composed of {皇|こう} (emperor, imperial) and {位|い} (position, rank). It refers specifically to the position of the Japanese Emperor ({天皇|てんのう}).

Note: Do not confuse with the homophones {好意|こうい} (goodwill, kindness) or {行為|こうい} (act, deed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇位|こうい}{継承|けいしょう} (imperial succession)
- {皇位|こうい}に{就|つ}く (ascend to the throne)
- {皇位|こうい}を{退|しりぞ}く (abdicate)
- {皇位|こうい}{継承|けいしょう}{順位|じゅんい} (order of succession to the throne)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In 2019, Emperor Akihito ({上皇|じょうこう}明仁) abdicated — the first such abdication in over 200 years — and Emperor Naruhito ({今上天皇|きんじょうてんのう}徳仁) ascended the {皇位|こうい}, beginning the Reiwa era.
